zh.title: 聯合航空短程航班開放餐點預訂 每日多6.5萬名旅客可使用
zh.summary: 聯合航空擴大短程航班餐點預訂，每日多6.5萬名旅客可使用
body: Simple Flying報導稱，聯合航空旅客現在可在較短程航班預訂餐點，每日可使用這項服務的旅客增加6.5萬名。這項報導所述的變化，涉及短程航班上的餐點預訂服務，以及每日可使用服務的人數增加。
報導摘要另稱，近期政策變更使這項服務每天新增適用於400多個航班。這是每日新增提供餐點預訂服務的航班數；6.5萬則是每日新增可使用服務的旅客人數。兩項數字分別呈現報導所述的航班與旅客增加情況。

en.title: United Airlines Adds Meal Preordering on Shorter Flights for 65,000 More Flyers Daily
en.summary: United Airlines extends meal preordering to shorter flights, reaching 65,000 more flyers daily.
body: Simple Flying reports that United Airlines flyers can now preorder food on shorter flights, with 65,000 more flyers a day able to use the service. The figure describes the reported daily increase in flyers able to access meal preordering on these flights.

The report's summary separately says a recent policy change has resulted in the service becoming available on more than 400 extra flights every day. That figure concerns additional flights offering the service each day, while the 65,000 figure concerns additional flyers able to use it. The two numbers describe separate reported measures of the expansion.

zh.summary: 報導稱馬斯克回應達美航空執行長談及拒絕Starlink的說法
body: Simple Flying報導稱，Elon Musk針對達美航空執行長Ed Bastian據報談及拒絕Starlink的說法作出回應。報導摘要表示，Bastian據報在公司活動中向員工說明，航空公司拒絕Starlink的理由是「we do not want to be with Elon Musk. Trust me.」

The report summary says Bastian reportedly told staff at a company event that the carrier turned down Starlink because, in the wording provided, “we do not want to be with Elon Musk. Trust me.”
The summary says Bastian reportedly cited Musk’s reputation as a reason for rejecting Starlink, linking the airline’s decision to his view of Musk. It describes Musk as responding after those claims.

zh.title: Archer完成舊金山灣區載人示範飛行 Midnight自奧克蘭機場起降
zh.summary: Archer於10月19日宣佈完成一系列載人示範飛行；Midnight eVTOL原型機以奧克蘭國際機場為起降點，行經灣區多個地點。
body: Archer Aviation於2026年10月19日宣佈，已在先前數週完成一系列飛越舊金山灣區的載人飛行。這家先進空中移動開發商表示，這批飛行屬於其所稱的「No Roads」巡迴展示的一部分。
根據Archer說法，這批飛行以奧克蘭國際機場（OAK）為起點與終點，使用一架Midnight eVTOL原型機。Midnight自其位於加州薩利納斯的基地起飛，該地約在奧克蘭以南100英里（160公里）。
沿途停留地點包括霍利斯特、聖馬丁、聖荷西、山景城與海沃德。Archer表示，在整段旅程中，其示範機得以在日益複雜的空域環境中操作。
Archer指出，這次巡迴展示的主要目的，是展示Midnight eVTOL在具備繁忙空中走廊的市區運作的能力，範圍涵蓋三座國際機場：舊金山國際機場（SFO）、聖荷西國際機場（SJC）以及奧克蘭國際機場（OAK）。Archer也表示，預期這次巡迴能讓居民一窺eVTOL航空器在灣區這類壅塞市區可提供的移動優勢。
AeroTime報導指出，Archer的競爭對手Joby Aviation曾於2026年3月在灣區執行一系列類似的示範飛行。

en.title: Archer completes piloted demonstration flights over San Francisco Bay area
en.summary: Archer said it completed piloted Midnight eVTOL flights starting and ending at Oakland International Airport (OAK) over preceding weeks.
body: Archer Aviation announced on October 19, 2026 that it had completed a series of piloted flights over the San Francisco Bay area during the preceding weeks. The advanced air mobility developer said the flights formed part of what it calls its 'No Roads' tour.

According to Archer, the flights started and ended at Oakland International Airport (OAK) and involved a Midnight eVTOL prototype. The Midnight aircraft flew from its base at Salinas, California, about 100 miles (160 km) south of Oakland.

Stops along the way included Hollister, San Martin, San Jose, Mountain View and Hayward. Archer said its demonstrator operated in increasingly more complex airspace environments throughout the journey.

Archer said the main purpose of the tour was to demonstrate the capability of the Midnight eVTOL to operate in an urban area with a busy air corridor, covering three international airports: San Francisco International (SFO), San José International Airport (SJC) and Oakland International Airport. Archer also said it expected the tour to give residents a glimpse of the mobility advantages eVTOL aircraft can provide in congested urban areas such as the Bay Area.
AeroTime reported that Archer's rival, Joby Aviation, conducted a series of similar demonstration flights over the Bay Area in March 2026.

zh.title: ExecuJet Haite簽約取得北京大興國際機場（PKX）地面服務權
zh.summary: ExecuJet Haite簽約在北京大興國際機場（PKX）提供地面服務，並將立即招募團隊。
body: ExecuJet Haite Aviation Services China表示，已與Capital Airport Holding Business Aviation Management（CBM）簽署具約束力的協議，將在北京大興國際機場（PKX）提供地面服務。公司表示，將立即為地面服務團隊展開招募。
ExecuJet Haite在大興提供航線技術人員與客戶支援服務，內容類似其依另一份協議在北京首都國際機場（PEK）提供的服務。公司在大興已營運維修、修理及大修（MRO）設施；這項協議擴大其在該機場的業務角色。

en.title: ExecuJet Haite signs ground-handling agreement at Beijing Daxing Airport
en.summary: ExecuJet Haite signs a binding ground-handling agreement for Beijing Daxing International Airport (PKX) and plans immediate team hiring.
body: ExecuJet Haite Aviation Services China says it has signed a binding agreement with Capital Airport Holding Business Aviation Management (CBM) to provide ground-handling services at Beijing Daxing International Airport (PKX). The company says it will begin hiring for its ground-handling team immediately.

At Daxing, ExecuJet Haite will provide line technician and customer support services, similar to those it has offered at Beijing Capital International Airport (PEK) under a separate agreement signed two years ago. The company already operates a maintenance, repair and overhaul facility at Daxing, and the new deal expands its role there.

body: 新加坡航空（Singapore Airlines）規劃開航一條飛行時間8小時的長程新航線，並將以每日空中巴士A350航班營運。

報導並指出，新加坡航空的每日A350航班將成為這座全新澳洲機場首個廣體客機客運服務。
目前公開的資訊僅限於此一新航線的開航時程、機型與目的地機場性質，尚未提及航線的具體城市、航班編號、時刻或票務安排。

body: 維珍大西洋航空於2026年10月18日開通倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）至泰國普吉國際機場（HKT）的直飛航班。這是希斯洛與泰國這處海濱目的地之間的首條直飛服務，航線採冬季季節性營運，使用波音787-9客機。
根據航空分析公司Cirium的時刻資料，這條航線預定每週營運三班，從10月中旬持續至3月下旬。VS214預定於當地時間15時45分自希斯洛起飛，翌日上午9時55分抵達普吉，表定飛行時間為12小時10分鐘。

en.title: Virgin Atlantic launches London Heathrow Airport (LHR)–Phuket International Airport (HKT) flights
en.summary: Virgin Atlantic launched its first nonstop London Heathrow Airport (LHR)–Phuket International Airport (HKT) flights on October 18, 2026.
body: Virgin Atlantic began nonstop flights between London Heathrow Airport (LHR) and Phuket International Airport (HKT) in Thailand on October 18, 2026. The service is the first direct connection between Heathrow and the Thai beach destination. The airline is operating the route as a seasonal winter service using Boeing 787-9 aircraft.

Schedule data from aviation analytics company Cirium indicate that the route is planned to operate three times a week from mid-October until late March. Flight VS214 is scheduled to leave Heathrow at 15:45 local time and arrive in Phuket at 09:55 the next day, with a scheduled flight time of 12 hours and 10 minutes.

zh.title: Qantas Freight與Australia Post接收首架新增空中巴士A321貨機，迎接年末旺季
zh.summary: Qantas Freight與Australia Post接收首架新增A321貨機，為年末旺季增加運能
body: Qantas Freight與Australia Post已接收三架新增空中巴士A321客改貨機中的首架。消息於2026年10月19日公佈，兩家公司表示，增加運能是為了因應年末購物旺季。
其餘兩架預計於2027年3月前加入Qantas Freight機隊。Qantas表示，三架飛機全部投入服務後，將使其為Australia Post營運的專用貨機網路運能增加最多20%。
每趟航班可運送最多20,000件Australia Post及StarTrack包裹。這些貨機將支援全國隔夜及次日配送，服務Qantas Freight所有國內貨運航站。

en.title: Qantas Freight and Australia Post receive first additional Airbus A321 freighter
en.summary: Qantas Freight and Australia Post receive their first additional A321 freighter ahead of the year-end peak.
body: Qantas Freight and Australia Post have received the first of three additional Airbus A321 Passenger-to-Freighter aircraft. The delivery was announced on October 19, 2026, as the companies add capacity ahead of the busy year-end shopping season.

The other two aircraft are scheduled to join the Qantas Freight fleet by March 2027. According to Qantas, once all three are in service, they will add up to 20% capacity to the dedicated freighter network it operates for Australia Post.

Each flight will be able to carry up to 20,000 Australia Post and StarTrack parcels. The freighters will support overnight and next-day deliveries nationwide, serving all of Qantas Freight’s domestic terminals.

zh.title: 德國萊比錫-哈雷機場圍籬遭車輛衝撞 警方調查中
zh.summary: 德國萊比錫-哈雷機場（LEJ）圍籬疑遭車輛衝撞；警方調查中，未有人被捕
body: 德國當局正調查一起發生在萊比錫-哈雷機場的疑似闖入事件。據官方消息人士於2026年10月18日轉述的報導，一輛汽車疑似在2026年10月17日至18日夜間衝撞機場周邊圍籬，向內行駛數公尺後逃離現場。
AeroTime報導指出，事發區域距離數架自2022年2月起停放於該機場的俄羅斯貨機停放位置相對接近。報導稱，至少三架安託諾夫An-124貨機自俄烏戰爭爆發、歐盟對俄羅斯航空器關閉空域後，便停放在萊比錫-哈雷機場。
萊比錫-哈雷國際機場是歐洲最大的航空貨運樞紐之一，報導稱其在戰爭期間一直是運送烏克蘭物資的關鍵通道。
報導指出，截至2026年10月19日，這起萊比錫機場（LEJ）闖入未遂事件尚無官方歸責，也未有任何嫌疑人被捕。

en.title: German authorities investigate attempted perimeter breach at Leipzig-Halle airport (LEJ)
en.summary: Police investigate attempted Leipzig-Halle airport (LEJ) perimeter breach; car reportedly rammed fence, no suspects detained
body: German authorities are investigating an attempt to breach the perimeter of Leipzig-Halle airport (LEJ) in Germany, according to official sources reported on October 18, 2026. According to those reports, a car appears to have rammed through one of the fences protecting the airport perimeter during the night of October 17 to 18, 2026, and driven a few meters inside before fleeing the scene.

AeroTime reported that the incident happened in an area relatively close to where several impounded Russian cargo aircraft have been stationed since February 2022. At least three Antonov An-124 cargo planes, belonging to Russian air freight operator Volga-Dnepr Group, have been grounded at Leipzig-Halle airport since the start of the war in Ukraine, when the European Union closed its airspace to Russian aircraft.
Leipzig-Halle International Airport is one of Europe's largest air cargo hubs and, according to the report, has played a key role in channeling supplies for Ukraine throughout the war.
As of October 19, 2026, the report states there is no official attribution of the attempted break-in at Leipzig Airport and no suspects have been apprehended.

zh.title: 松山機場遷建議題 蔣萬安稱願與中央把配套做到位
zh.summary: 蔣萬安拋松山機場遷建政見；民調41%不支持31%支持；秦慧珠提議地方公投
body: 臺北市長蔣萬安拋出遷建松山機場政見，各界持續關注。中央社報導，最新民調顯示41%不支持，大過支持的31%。
國民黨議員秦慧珠提出將自提舉辦地方性公投，於2028年總統大選時投票。
蔣萬安19日受訪時說，願意聆聽各界意見，也跟中央一起面對遇到的困難，一一克服。
他並提到，包括桃園國際機場（TPE）第三航廈、第三跑道的完成，2027、2033年這段期間可積極盤點，一起將相關的配套做到位。
行政院祕書長張惇涵說，遷建松機不是看幾張PPT就可以討論的。蔣萬安回應「當然不是啊！」
蔣萬安表示，市府從民國112年的公文告訴中央，認為遷建松機對北市未來發展有利，也是市民共同的期待，希望交通部納入整體計畫。

en.title: Taipei mayor says he will work with central government on Songshan airport relocation
en.summary: Chiang Wan-an backs Songshan relocation plan; poll shows 41% opposed, 31% in support; councillor proposes local referendum
body: Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an has put forward a policy proposal to relocate Songshan Airport, and the issue continues to draw attention. A recent poll cited by CNA showed 41% did not support the plan, more than the 31% who supported it.
Kuomintang councillor Chin Hui-chu proposed initiating a local referendum, to be held alongside the 2028 presidential election.
Speaking to reporters on October 19, Chiang said he is willing to listen to opinions from all sides and to face difficulties together with the central government and overcome them one by one.

He also mentioned the completion of Taoyuan International Airport (TPE)'s Terminal 3 and third runway, saying the period between 2027 and 2033 could be used to actively take stock and put related supporting measures in place.
Executive Yuan Secretary-General Chang Tun-han said relocating Songshan Airport cannot be discussed by looking at a few PowerPoint slides. Chiang responded, "Of course not!"

Chiang said the city government had told the central government in a 2023 official document that it believes relocating Songshan Airport benefits Taipei's future development and is a shared expectation of residents, and hoped the Ministry of Transportation and Communications would include it in overall planning.

zh.title: 臺灣接收首批兩架新造F-16V 預期數週內再有兩架抵達
zh.summary: 臺灣已接收首批兩架新造F-16V，並預期數週內再有兩架抵達。
body: 臺灣已接收首批兩架新造F-16V戰機。兩架戰機在夏威夷停留一段時間後，於十月三日抵達臺東縣的 Chihhang Air Base。報導指出，這是臺灣2019年採購66架戰機的合約下，首批交付的新造F-16戰機。
報導引述Taipei Times指出，66架戰機中有6架已完成工廠驗收並下線，其中兩架已在臺灣，另兩架在美國一處基地進行訓練，還有兩架正在測試。
報導稱，臺灣預期數週內還會有兩架F-16V抵達。Lockheed Martin的Block 70交付速度仍未達目標；報導指出，該公司2025年交付16架，與2024年相同。

en.title: Taiwan receives first two new-build F-16Vs, expects two more within weeks
en.summary: Taiwan receives its first two new-build F-16Vs and expects two more within weeks.
body: Taiwan has received its first two new-build F-16V fighter jets after an extended stay in Hawaii. They arrived at Chihhang Air Base in Taitung County on the 3rd of October. The report says they are the first new-build F-16s delivered under Taiwan’s delayed 2019 contract for 66 aircraft.

The report, citing the Taipei Times, says six of the 66 fighters have completed factory acceptance and rolled off the production line. Two are already in Taiwan, two are at a US base for training, and two are undergoing testing.

Taiwan expects two more F-16Vs within weeks, according to the report. It also says Lockheed Martin has been delayed in reaching its Block 70 delivery target, delivering 16 aircraft in 2025, the same number as in 2024.

zh.title: 全日空Chiikawa主題波音767首航東京羽田至長崎
zh.summary: 全日空Chiikawa主題波音767於19 October從東京羽田首航長崎
body: 全日空（All Nippon Airways，ANA）的Chiikawa主題波音767於19 October投入客運，首次從東京羽田飛往長崎，執飛航班為NH661。報導指出，這架波音767-300ER註冊編號為JA609A，當地時間上午8時26分自羽田機場起飛，機上載有270名乘客；首航班機已客滿。
機身彩繪呈現Chiikawa系列的八個角色，機艙備有特別設計的頭枕套，乘客也會收到以Chiikawa角色為主題的紙杯飲品。全日空表示，從25 October起，該機將依冬季班表飛往多個航點，包括札幌、大阪、福岡、沖繩及松山。

en.title: ANA's Chiikawa-Themed Boeing 767 Begins Passenger Service
en.summary: ANA's Chiikawa-themed Boeing 767 made its first passenger flight from Tokyo Haneda to Nagasaki on 19 October.
body: All Nippon Airways (ANA) began passenger service with its Chiikawa-themed Boeing 767 on 19 October. The aircraft made its first flight from Tokyo Haneda to Nagasaki as Flight NH661. The Boeing 767-300ER, registered as JA609A, departed Haneda Airport at 8.26am local time with 270 passengers on board. The report said the inaugural service was fully booked.

The livery features eight characters from Chiikawa. The cabin has specially designed headrest covers, and passengers will be served drinks in Chiikawa-themed paper cups. ANA says that from 25 October the aircraft will follow its winter schedule and fly to destinations including Sapporo, Osaka, Fukuoka, Okinawa and Matsuyama.

zh.title: 利雅德機場重開後多家航空公司仍暫停航班
zh.summary: 利雅德機場恢復營運，多家航空公司仍延長航班停飛安排
body: King Khalid International Airport 於 10 月 18 日重新開放並恢復營運，機場此前已關閉超過一週。報導指出，飛往利雅德的航班預計逐步恢復。
多家航空公司的航班安排仍未恢復：漢莎航空飛往利雅德的航班暫停至 11 月 18 日；荷蘭皇家航空利雅德與達曼航班取消至 10 月 31 日；法國航空利雅德服務暫停至 10 月 24 日。達美航空已將原訂 10 月 23 日開辦的亞特蘭大—利雅德航線延至 2027 年 3 月，相關日期可能隨航空公司重新評估安全情勢而變動。

en.title: Riyadh Airport Reopens as Airlines Maintain Flight Suspensions
en.summary: King Khalid International Airport resumes operations, while carriers keep Riyadh services suspended.
body: King Khalid International Airport reopened on 18 October and resumed operations after more than a week of closure. Flights to Riyadh are expected to return gradually.

Lufthansa flights to Riyadh remain suspended through 18 November. KLM flights to Riyadh and Dammam remain cancelled through 31 October, while Air France services to Riyadh are suspended until 24 October. Delta Air Lines postponed the launch of its Atlanta–Riyadh flights, which had been scheduled for 23 October, until March 2027. The listed dates may change as carriers reassess security conditions.

zh.title: 羅馬尼亞F-16擊落兩架疑似俄羅斯Geran-4無人機
zh.summary: 羅馬尼亞公佈F-16擊落兩架疑似俄羅斯Geran-4無人機畫面
body: 羅馬尼亞週日公佈畫面，顯示F-16戰機在羅馬尼亞領海擊落兩架疑似俄羅斯Geran-4無人機。報導引述國防部長Radu Miruta向路透社表示，無人機當時以每小時450公里飛行；他據此認為它們可能是俄製、配備渦輪噴射引擎的Geran-4。無人機型號仍以疑似描述。
報導引述軍方訊息指出，第一架無人機於17時59分進入羅馬尼亞領空，並在兩分鐘內於蘇利納東南方25公里處遭擊落。第二架在同一區域遭攔截，於18時05分、進入領空四分鐘後被擊落；報導所載軍方說法稱，其位置在蘇利納以東20公里。

en.title: Romanian F-16s shoot down two suspected Russian Geran-4 drones
en.summary: Romania releases footage of F-16s shooting down two suspected Russian Geran-4 drones.
body: Romania published footage on Sunday showing its F-16 fighter jets shooting down two suspected Russian Geran-4 drones over Romanian territorial waters. The report quoted Defence Minister Radu Miruta telling Reuters that the drones had been flying at 450 km/h, leading him to think they were Russian-made Geran-4 drones with turbojet engines. The drones’ identification was described as suspected.

The report also said Romania’s military reported that the first drone entered national airspace at 17:59 and was shot down within two minutes, 25 km southeast of Sulina. A second drone was engaged and shot down in the same area at 18:05, four minutes after entering the airspace; the reported location was 20 km east of Sulina.
